messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: This medicine may cause seizures, especially in people with certain medical conditions or when using certain drugs. Tell your doctor about all of your medical conditions and the drugs you use.
Bupropion can cause mild pupillary dilation, which can lead to an episode of angle-closure glaucoma in susceptible individuals. Angle-closure glaucoma has occurred in patients with untreated anatomically narrow angles treated with antidepressants.
Triplet: ["angle-closure glaucoma", "occurs in", "patients treated with antidepressants"]

The relation 'occurs in' in the triplet is defined as 'The medical condition specified by the subject entity is associated with or found in the group of individuals described by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
B. 'used in': The subject drug is utilized in the medical procedure or clinical context specified by the object entity.
C. 'involves buildup of': The subject condition involves the accumulation of the substance specified by the object entity.
D. 'should inform doctor about': Patients taking the subject drug should tell their doctor about the condition or circumstance specified by the object entity.
E. 'use with caution in': The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
